evidence_type: implementation-only actual local CPU file-ASR benchmark; independently rescored retained outputs
result: Baseline passes the fixed human-set accuracy and speed gates. Candidate passes accuracy but fails speed on all twelve human clips and the separate v2 warm call. The entire predeclared suite fails.

source_and_configuration.build: Rust1.94.1; development profile, local/core opt0, third-party dependencies opt2; CPU only; same binary for every profile
source_and_configuration.identity_limit: Endpoint identities, not a continuous/atomic external-filesystem snapshot. Loader owns model bytes after reading; WAV hash and decoding use the same bounded buffer.

hardware_recorded_at_run.limits: Single sequential profile worker; no independent host CPU-load/process tracing or release-build performance claim.

dataset.attribution: LibriSpeech (c)2014 Vassil Panayotov; publisher declares CC-BY-4.0. Dataset notices/legal text are retained in the frozen acquisition proposal.
dataset.selection: First eligible utterance per speaker, first twelve numeric speakers, selected from metadata before model output.
dataset.audio: Frozen mono16kHz PCM16, lossless FLAC-to-WAV conversion; no new audio/capture in this run.

execution_accounting.outer_exit: Root reported launcher exit1; independently verified failed suite accounting. The evaluator did not observe the outer job directly.

runtime_network_checks.worker_policy: deny network* and writes beneath fixed model/input roots
runtime_network_checks.scope: Canary and code/event ordering; no packet audit or denied-syscall trace claimed. Compilation network behavior is separate.

acceptance_declared_before_inference.v2_cold_role: Retained diagnostic; warm gate matches the original smoke test.
acceptance_declared_before_inference.normalizer: Exact Rust lowercase + punctuation removal + whitespace split. No number expansion/equivalence; punctuation is removed without replacement.
acceptance_declared_before_inference.metric: Independent full edit-distance matrix on ASCII references/raw API text; each per-call token/error/count/WER result matches the recorded Rust scorer. Corpus micro-WER is sum(errors)/279.
acceptance_declared_before_inference.timing: Whole Transcriber::transcribe API includes frontend/encoder/decoder. Model load and WAV hash/PCM conversion are excluded from decode_ms, but inside profile wall time. Cold means first decode after new load, not cold disk cache.
acceptance_declared_before_inference.tail_statistics: Nearest-rank p90/p95 over the twelve fixed scored clips, descriptive only; v2 has one warm sample, not a population tail estimate.

latency_descriptive_scored_calls.quantile_definition: nearest rank ceil(p*n), descriptive for this fixed set only

scope_limits: Twelve clean read-English utterances, one per selected speaker, from a public test subset. This is not full LibriSpeech, broad-language/accent/overlap quality, blind/unseen-data proof or reference parity.
File transcription only: no microphone/system-audio routing, capture permissions, live endpointing/finalization, diarization or UI workflow was exercised.
A human-set pass does not clear the prior base.en v2 accuracy failure. Candidate v2 accuracy passes the exact boundary while its speed gate fails.
No model/profile/default/normalizer/threshold was changed and no output was retried to pass.
All original preparation failures, v1 accounting defect, prior v2 failures and this suite failure remain preserved.
Evaluator only read, hashed, parsed PCM and recomputed text metrics. No model construction, ASR worker/scorer rerun, Cargo, capture, playback, GUI or source edits occurred.
